### Germán Eduardo Barriga González

**Associate professor · Department of Chemistry, UMCE**

PhD in Chemistry (Universidad de Chile). His work combines organic chemistry, free radicals, computational reactivity, initial teacher education and digital learning resources.

## Networks and collaborators

::: {.cards}
::: {.feature}
### LabTec — Technology Laboratory

A space dedicated to developing technologies for the education of science and technology teachers, led by Professor **Mg. Yonnhatan García Cartagena**, established in 2010. Professor **David Reyes** takes part.

[Visit LabTec](https://sites.google.com/umce.cl/labtec/home)
:::
::: {.feature}
### Semillero CATIÓN

**Science, didactics and innovation.** A space created in 2023, led by Professor **Dr. Carla Olivares Petit**, focused on science didactics. Professor **Bernardo Madariaga** takes part: Physics teacher at UMCE with a master's degree in Natural Science Didactics from UMCE, working in science education.
:::
::: {.feature}
### José Muñoz Espinoza

Chemistry teacher at UMCE with a master's degree in Chemistry from Universidad de Chile. Collaborator in **computational chemical reactivity**.
:::
